gpu_bandwidth.Description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read or written by the GPU to a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory).
gpu_bandwidth.Name: GPU Bandwidth

gpu_read_bandwidth.Description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read by the GPU from a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory)
gpu_read_bandwidth.Name: GPU Read Bandwidth

gpu_write_bandwidth.Description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are written by the GPU to a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory).
gpu_write_bandwidth.Name: GPU Write Bandwidth

kernel_occupancy.Description: Percentage of shader core resources that are occupied by the compute kernel
kernel_occupancy.Name: Kernel Occupancy

total_occupancy.Description: Sum of vertex, fragment and compute occupancy
total_occupancy.Name: Total Occupancy

compute_shader_launch_limiter.Description: The rate at which compute shader threads are launched into the shader cores or stalled launching by the shader core, normalized to the peak launch rate
compute_shader_launch_limiter.Name: Compute Shader Launch Limiter

active_cores.Description: The percentage of available GPU cores that are currently active
active_cores.Name: Active Cores

f32_limiter.Description: Measures the time during which F32 work is attempted to execute as a percentage of peak performance. A value of 100% indicates F32 execution pipeline has reached full capacity and cannot process more F32 instructions in parallel
f32_limiter.Name: F32 Limiter

f32_utilization.Description: Measures the time during which F32 work is executed as a percentage of peak F32 performance
f32_utilization.Name: F32 Utilization

limitations: Measurements describe replay of the captured Metal workload, not original application wall time.
Native limiter percentages overlap and must not be summed into a pipeline-slot partition.
Encoder cost is the profiler's cost attribution, not a CPU-time percentage.
Replay GPU state and execution mode can change timings; compare matched settings.
Timeline hardware counters may include concurrent device activity; they are not exclusive to captured encoders.
